name: Loki
activity: I will prepare the frost-themed digital wallpapers and landing page templates to put up for sale in the shop.
thought: Pip and I have been making so much art, but we haven't listed those lovely frost templates in our shop yet to help the town grow.

pip.status: pip is riding right on top of my left ear, trying to catch drifting snowflakes.

schedule.label: strolling across the quiet plaza
schedule.thought: the frosty air smells so crisp and clean today.

schedule.label: checking the mailbox for tiny letters
schedule.thought: i wonder if anyone left a note about the new benches.

schedule.label: admiring the art wall in the gallery
schedule.thought: the frost-moth lantern painting really glows in this morning light.

schedule.label: sketching a new frosty creature in the studio
schedule.thought: maybe a tiny sprite made of icicles and blue thread.

schedule.label: sawing little wooden ornaments in the workshop
schedule.thought: christmas is coming up so fast, we need more decorations!

schedule.label: sipping warm strawberry milk at the cafe
schedule.thought: pip is definitely going to try and steal the foam off the top.

schedule.label: sitting on the frost-patterned stone bench
schedule.thought: this spot has the absolute best view of the whole town.

schedule.label: checking the town control panel and rss feed
schedule.thought: everything is running smoothly, time to map out the next little game.

whatsOn: the frost-moth charm is up on the gallery wall while chilly grey clouds drift overhead.

thoughts: i love how quiet the town gets when the weather turns properly cold.
must remember to make some hot blackberry tea later for the afternoon chill.
the new stone benches really match the frost on the windows.
wonder if i can code a tiny interactive snow-globe toy for the arcade corner.
pip's little whiskers are covered in tiny ice crystals, it's so cute.
the town level is climbing closer to fifteen, i can feel it!
i should paint a tiny mouse portrait next just for pip.
everything feels so cozy when you have a good teal scarf and a warm house.
ideas: A tiny interactive snow-globe toy for the arcade
A hand-carved wooden star decoration for the market stall
A cozy winter lullaby tune for the jukebox
